description: This file defines the class S3ExpressIdentityProvider, which provides identity management for AWS S3 using session credentials and caching. It implements an invokable method to create or retrieve identities, utilizing AWS SDK components and Guzzle promises.

classes.name: S3ExpressIdentityProvider
classes.description: Provides a way to get S3 identity credentials with caching, encapsulating the logic to create or retrieve temporary session credentials for AWS S3 access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a region and optional configuration, setting up the cache and storing parameters.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a command to create or fetch an S3 identity, utilizing cache if available or creating a new session.

methods.name: getS3Client
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the S3 client instance, either from config or by creating a new one with specified options.
